facts: Parties: Marlow Marine Ltd (Buyer), Thornbury Holdings Ltd (Seller); the Company is Marlow Media Ltd.
This Agreement is dated 18 December 2025; Closing is scheduled for 10 March 2026 (the 'Closing Date').

Section 10.1 (Survival): the General Warranties survive Closing for 18 months; the Fundamental Warranties (title, capacity, tax) survive for 36 months. Claims must be notified in writing before expiry.

Section 8.2 (Limitation of Liability): the aggregate liability of the Seller for warranty claims shall not exceed an amount equal to 12% of the Purchase Price, being $21,600,000. The Purchase Price is $200,000,000 (see Section 2.1).

Clause 14.2: either party may terminate this agreement on 30 days' notice if the other party undergoes a change of control without its prior written consent. The counterparty is Foxley Engineering Ltd.
Disclosure against Warranty 6.3 (Material Contracts): no material contract contains a change of control provision. (No further disclosure.)
Present: 2 directors (of 5). The meeting was quorate. RESOLVED to approve entry into the Share Purchase Agreement.
Article 11: the quorum for board meetings is three directors.
